observations: Viewed all 12 actual baseline/candidate PNGs: both face crops and full stages for adult head, adult supporting hand, and narrow infant high-contrast views.

Adult head: the central closed-mouth crease is more continuous and its inner lip edge reads more evenly. The change is subtle at full-stage size; head silhouette, nose, eyelids, orientation, and framing remain stable.

Adult supporting hand: the shallow lip contour remains integrated with the face and the central line is cleaner from the oblique angle. Supporting-hand overlap, neck join, head tilt, and framing show no visible regression.

Infant high contrast: the small mouth contour remains distinct against the face and retains its closed shape. The change is slight; white face silhouette, dark torso, hand visibility, and narrow framing remain stable.
Accept as a focused mouth surface refinement. Some fine stippling remains on thin contours; these images do not support claiming a broad realism transformation.
limitations: Three matched raw-module browser views only. Full application loader, build, deployment, interactive motion, and other camera angles were not visually tested.
